components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The established CTA on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:46px; padding:0 24px; font-family:'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; letter-spacing:0.01em; color:#3a2600; background:#F4A300; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,25,11,0.06),0 2px 6px rgba(16,25,11,0.05); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1),box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1),background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#ffb01f; transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(16,25,11,0.05),0 8px 20px -6px rgba(16,25,11,0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(93,158,135,0.45); }

components.name: Hero Button
components.description: Green-to-turquoise gradient CTA for the biggest moments.
components.css: .ds-btn-hero { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:46px; padding:0 24px; font-family:'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; color:#ffffff; border:none; border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2D5016 0%,#356b59 100%); box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(16,25,11,0.05),0 8px 20px -6px rgba(16,25,11,0.12); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1),box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-btn-hero:hover { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#366021 0%,#3f7d68 100%); transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(16,25,11,0.05),0 18px 40px -12px rgba(16,25,11,0.18),0 6px 20px -6px rgba(93,158,135,0.5); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(93,158,135,0.45); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:46px; padding:0 24px; font-family:'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; color:#356b59; background:#eef6f2; border:1px solid #c4ddd2; border-radius:999px; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1),background-color 200ms,border-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#dcebe4; border-color:#5d9e87; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(93,158,135,0.45); }

components.name: Card

components.css: .ds-card { background:#ffffff; border:1px solid rgba(16,25,11,0.08); border-radius:24px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,25,11,0.06),0 2px 6px rgba(16,25,11,0.05); padding:1.75rem; transition:transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1),box-shadow 200ms,border-color 200ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(16,25,11,0.05),0 18px 40px -12px rgba(16,25,11,0.18); border-color:#c4ddd2; } .ds-card-title { font-family:'Archivo Black',sans-serif; font-size:1.15rem; color:#243016; letter-spacing:-0.01em; margin:0; } .ds-card-sub { font-family:'Nunito',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.85rem; color:#6b7360; margin:0.25rem 0 0; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; font-family:'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:700; color:#2D5016; letter-spacing:0.01em; margin-bottom:0.4rem; } .ds-field-input { width:100%; height:46px; padding:0 0.9rem; font-family:'Nunito',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; color:#2C2C2C; background:#ffffff; border:1px solid rgba(16,25,11,0.14); border-radius:14px; outline:none; transition:border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1),box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color:#9aa290; } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color:rgba(16,25,11,0.26); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { border-color:#5d9e87; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(93,158,135,0.45); }

components.description: Colored dot + text label for market state; red/orange/green. Never color alone.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; font-family:'DM Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600; color:#D32F2F; } .ds-status-dot { width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:#D32F2F; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(211,47,47,0.18); flex-shrink:0; }

narrative.overview: AgriPulse takes what is literally in the soil and turns it into foresight. Deep highland earth-greens are the ground, lit by grey-turquoise (#5d9e87) for data, state and trust, and a rare harvest-lime for growth. Marketing surfaces drench the viewer in near-black forest green; working tools sit on warm cream so numbers stay legible. The design serves two audiences with one component vocabulary: dense and report-grade for the LGU officer, Facebook-simple for the farmer.
keyCharacteristics: Earthy, drenched deep-greens on brand surfaces; warm cream on working tools.
One rare harvest-lime for growth moments; grey-turquoise for data, state, and trust.
Confident display type (Archivo Black) over friendly body type (Nunito / DM Sans).
Soft rounding (14-24px) and earth-tinted shadows, never neutral black.

rules.name: The Harvest-Lime Rule
rules.body: Harvest-lime (#D6E85C) marks growth and reward only. As a background or decorative fill, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Green-Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Grays are forbidden. Muted text is #6b7360; shadows are tinted toward rgba(16,25,11,...), never neutral black.

rules.name: The Numbers-Are-Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any figure that updates or aligns in a column carries tabular-nums. Money and hectares never dance.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Intent Rule
rules.body: Cards rest flat-ish and lift only on hover or focus. Motion conveys the state.

dos: Do keep the established theme: deep earth-greens as ground, grey-turquoise (#5d9e87) for data/state/trust, harvest-lime for growth moments only.
Do put working tools on cream (#F8F7F2) and drench marketing surfaces in deep green (#10190B).
Do pair every status color with a text label and a dot; never rely on color alone.
Do use tinted, earth-toned shadows and green-tinted muted text (#6b7360).
Do reuse the shared vocabulary (.btn, .card, .field-input, .badge) across both audiences.
Do keep the global turquoise focus ring on every interactive element.
donts: Don't make it look like a sterile government portal: no gray, dense, bureaucratic form-walls.
Don't make it look like a cold corporate agritech SaaS: no navy-and-gray chart-soup.
Don't make it childish or cartoonish: the income stakes are real.
Don't make it flashy crypto/fintech: no neon gradients, no hype-glow.
Don't use neutral grays or neutral-black shadows anywhere.
Don't use border-left (or any side) greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use harvest-lime as a background or decoration.
Don't set display inline on an element that relies on a *:hidden Tailwind class.
